recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It completes the applied FHIR-30758 semantics by removing stale medication-centric wording while preserving the already-correct structure and terminology.
issue_request: FHIR-30758 was an Applied/Persuasive R5 BRR request to rename otherTherapy.medication[x], add ActivityDefinition as a reference target, and broaden the example therapy ValueSet beyond drug therapy. Later Jira comments record that the final current element name is treatment and that SNOMED CT Therapeutic procedure was acceptable instead of all Procedure.
initial_application: 447e322ee6dae0af815d4430df0bfbae89dc9209 first applied the structural request by renaming medication[x] to therapy[x] and adding ActivityDefinition. ClinicalUseIssue was later renamed to ClinicalUseDefinition for FHIR-31847, FHIR-37921 renamed otherTherapy.therapy to otherTherapy.treatment, and 9d5ab5f45f584f5ee05d7c2056e417b8610f9cb4 widened ValueSet/therapy while retaining Therapeutic procedure.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini makes ClinicalUseDefinition the active normative current-build resource while ClinicalUseIssue is commented out. The current source already has ActivityDefinition and other product/nutrition/substance targets and the expected therapy ValueSet filters, but the treatment element short/definition still said it was a specific medication.
reconciliation: Updated only the ClinicalUseDefinition.indication.otherTherapy.treatment short and definition to describe a treatment that may be medication, substance, biologically derived product, nutrition product, procedure, or other activity. No type, targetProfile, binding, ValueSet, example, or generated diagram source was changed.
